_meta.purpose: State and country allowlist for SpiralCoin LLC paid acquisition + signup eligibility. Used by assets/state-geofence.js when SPLC_GEO_MODE='allowlist'.
_meta.legalNote: Do NOT activate the US-state allowlist until SpiralCoin LLC holds a valid money transmitter license (or partner-MSB coverage) in each allowed state. This file is metadata for future use. Currently US is fully blocked via assets/geo-block.js.

us_states._explainer: Tiers represent regulatory friction for a crypto money services business. Tier 1 = most achievable first. Tier 4 = avoid unless materially funded.

tier1_friendly_or_low_friction.rationale: Wyoming has a crypto-specific Special Purpose Depository Institution framework; Texas does not require a separate MTL for purely software-only non-custodial activity (verify with counsel for your specific model); Florida MTL is achievable with moderate bond; New Hampshire and Montana have explicit crypto exemptions for certain activities. Verify current rules with counsel; they change.

tier2_workable.rationale: Standard MTL regime; achievable with a fintech attorney and standard bond/net-worth requirements.

tier3_hard.rationale: California (DFPI Digital Financial Assets Law, effective 2025), Washington, Hawaii, Louisiana have crypto-specific regimes; others have onerous bonding or capital requirements.

tier4_avoid_until_funded.rationale: BitLicense — typical legal+filing cost $100K-$500K, capital requirement $250K+, 12-24 month timeline. Most early-stage projects geofence NY entirely.

international._explainer: Country-level allowlist for non-US users. Aligns with Google Ads cryptocurrency allowed regions where SpiralCoin will operate first.
international._phase1_notes: Major markets where Google Ads permits crypto with certification; MiCA (EU) registration recommended before launching in EU production.
international._blocked_notes: OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions and US (until state-MTL/partner-MSB strategy is in place). Block list must be reviewed monthly against latest OFAC SDN updates.

before_enabling_any_us_state: State MTL granted OR partner-MSB agreement signed for that state
AML/KYC program live with vendor (Sumsub / Persona / Veriff)
Securities attorney memo confirming token sale structure for that state
Consumer-protection complaint handling procedure live (state-specific requirements)
before_enabling_international: FCA / ASIC / MAS guidance review (for UK/AU/SG)
Tax withholding / reporting requirements per country
Localized Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
